theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Vs : ℕ → ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (As : (k i : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Vs k i) n) (Ws : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Zs : (k : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Ws k) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Tendsto (fun i => currentEval (As k i) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) atTop (𝓝 (currentEval (Zs k) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)))) → ConvergesWeakly Zs C → (∀ R : ℕ, ∃ (k₀ : ℕ) (Γ : ℝ≥0∞), Γ ≠ ∞ ∧ C.massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ball (0 : Euclid P) ((R : ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Vs k i ∧ (As k i).massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun k => As k (φ k)) C
